entities.name: Anderson Hernández
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anderson Hernández Mejia is a Dominican former professional baseball infielder who currently serves as the third base coach and infield coach for the Bravos de León of the Mexican League. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the New York Mets, Washington Nationals, Cleveland Indians, and Houston Astros, and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Chunichi Dragons.
